source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Errata to the **[Ongoing Consolidation](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move)** part of the **Consolidation Move** rules:

- Each model that began the move **engaged** with an enemy unit must end it still engaged with the same enemy unit.
- Then your opponent must pick, one at a time, every enemy unit engaged with your unit not yet **selected to fight** in this phase; each picked unit is made **eligible to fight** and selected to fight.

enemyFight.target: enemies engaged with consolidating unit and not previously selected to fight this phase
